observations.code_quote: "description": "Usage so far this billing period. Per usage key it returns the usage, the limit in effect and today's usage where PostHog tracks it. It also says whether PostHog is limiting the resource right now. Per product and add-on it returns the current usage, limit, ratio and over-limit flag. It returns quantities only, with the last date the usage reports cover. It is an organization total, so it needs full billing access. billing-usage-timeseries-get reads the same numbers per project with usage read access, and billing-usage-status-get is the read for members. Use it for \"how many events have we used\". For amounts call billing-spend-summary-get, and for usage over time call billing-usage-timeseries-get. Beta: behind the organization-billing-api flag, and the output shape may change while it is.",
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the billing-usage-summary-get tool description and its relationship to billing-usage-timeseries-get and billing-usage-status-get. No implementation or test is supplied.

observations.code_quote: "description": "Usage over time as quantities, per usage type and per project. Pages by limit and cursor, and returns only the projects the caller can see. Needs usage read access. Owners always have it, and admins have it when owner-only billing is off. Members have it when owner-only billing is off and the organization allows member usage and spend reads. That member grant covers the series only, not the totals on billing-usage-summary-get. Use it to investigate a usage spike, compare periods, or attribute usage to projects. For usage so far this period call billing-usage-summary-get, and for dollar amounts call billing-spend-timeseries-get. Beta: behind the organization-billing-api flag, and the output shape may change while it is.",
